_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "published_year" INTEGER NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NULL, "cover_path" TEXT NULL, "spine_style" TEXT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES series (id), "series_index" REAL NULL, "reading_progress" REAL NULL, "last_read_page" INTEGER NULL, "last_read_at" INTEGER NULL, "reader_notes" TEXT NULL, "reader_notes_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "reader_notes_needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reader_notes_needs_push" IN (0, 1)), "source_metadata" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), "cover_etag" TEXT NULL, "needs_progress_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_progress_push" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unread', "rating" INTEGER NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "read_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "authors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_authors" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authors (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "author_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_genres" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "genre_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES genres (id), PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "genre_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "physical_copies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "location" TEXT NULL, "condition" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "copy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES physical_copies (id), "borrower" TEXT NOT NULL, "loaned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "returned_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "borrower_contact" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "reminder_sent_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "copy_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "copy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES physical_copies (id), "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "caption" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelf_books" ("shelf_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shelves (id), "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("shelf_id", "book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "physical_environments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "server_revision" INTEGER NULL, "needs_publish" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_publish" IN (0, 1)), "backdrop_path" TEXT NULL, "backdrop_opacity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "backdrop_scale" REAL NULL, "backdrop_offset_x" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "backdrop_offset_y" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "physical_shelves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "environment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES physical_environments (id), "x1" REAL NOT NULL, "y1" REAL NOT NULL, "x2" REAL NOT NULL, "y2" REAL NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shelf', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_placements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "environment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES physical_environments (id), "copy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES physical_copies (id), "x" REAL NOT NULL, "y" REAL NOT NULL, "rotation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "width_override" REAL NULL, "height_override" REAL NULL, "format" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_deletions" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'book', PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "remote_reading_positions" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_label" TEXT NULL, "progress" REAL NULL, "page" INTEGER NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "scroll" REAL NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "annotations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "page" INTEGER NULL, "chapter" INTEGER NULL, "locator" TEXT NULL, "quoted_text" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_page" INTEGER NULL, "end_page" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "device_label" TEXT NULL, "needs_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_push" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
